description: A grid sequencer with four playheads reading the same grid at their own lengths, divisions and octaves

outputs.text: The gates of all four playheads in one polyphonic signal

The gates under that playhead as one polyphonic signal; the menu sets whether a gate is a short trigger, a retriggered gate, or held until the next clock tick
To the right the outputs line up with the sixteen lowest rows whether or not a cell is on, which suits drum parts; to the left they carry the notes actually turned on

notes: click a cell in the grid to turn it on or off, and drag across the grid to paint a run of them
menu: Polyphony channels — sets how many channels each playhead's polyphonic outputs carry
Repeat 16 Steps — copies the first sixteen columns across the rest of the grid
Gate Mode — sets what the gate outputs do: Trigger fires a short pulse, Retrigger drops the gate for a moment before each new step, Continuous holds it until the next clock tick
Gate Length — sets how long a Trigger or Retrigger gate lasts, in milliseconds
